title: Weighted ball growth at a weighted approximate tangent space (Step 5)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Hⁿ-null-measurable, and let θ : ℝ^P → ℝ satisfy θ(y) ≥ 0 for y ∈ M, with θ Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Let x ∈ ℝ^P and let Q be a linear subspace with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q. Then there is C ∈ ℝ≥0 such that ∫⁻_{M ∩ B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ) dHⁿ ≤ C·ofReal(sⁿ) for all sufficiently small s > 0 (eventually in 𝓝[>] 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P)), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q → ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n)
